workflow.name: AI-powered concert ticket validation and fan experience orchestration
workflow.description: Automates end-to-end concert ticket booking validation and fan experience management using two coordinated AI agents. Prevents fraud, manages inventory, and delivers seamless customer communication.

OPENAI_API_KEY.description: OpenAI-compatible API key for AI agent calls

OPENAI_MODEL.description: Model name for AI agent calls

SAMPLE_BOOKING_PATH.description: Path to sample booking JSON file

workflow_steps.name: receive_booking
workflow_steps.description: Receive ticket booking request. Replaces Ticket Booking Webhook node.

workflow_steps.name: get_workflow_config
workflow_steps.description: Load workflow configuration. Replaces Workflow Configuration Set node.

workflow_steps.name: validate_ticket
workflow_steps.description: AI-powered ticket validation with fraud detection and risk scoring. Replaces Ticket Validation Agent + OpenAI + Output Parser.

workflow_steps.name: orchestrate_fan_experience
workflow_steps.description: AI-powered fan experience orchestration (low/medium risk path). Replaces Fan Experience Orchestration Agent + OpenAI + Output Parser.

workflow_steps.name: log_audit_trail
workflow_steps.description: Log booking outcome to audit trail. Replaces Merge All Paths + Log to Audit Trail Google Sheets node (mock → local CSV).
